# Capture Skill for Muse

A "fast-to-action, zero information loss" brain-dump organizer: pour a chaotic dump of ideas and tasks in, get back a structured four-section system — Projects & Ideas, Tasks, Connections, How I can help. Strong rules make it work: no intake ritual (the dump IS the request), at most one clarifying question, your voice preserved (anti corporate-speak), never invented connections (real Glob/Grep verification only), and no action without your approval. Bundled scripts inventory the workspace, classify the dump, and estimate complexity (compressed format for five items or fewer). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the "Connections" section depends on filesystem access (degraded outside Claude Code), and the output quality follows the dump's quality. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
